Marissa —

Thanks for the ping. Quick answers / plan:

1) Replay runbook summary (high-level):
- We ingest provided traffic dump (CSV/parquet) into our replay harness (redwood-runner).
- We scrub PII fields client-side if requested (we can accept sanitized datasets).
- Run three passes: low-intensity (baseline), expected-peak, stress (1.5x peak).
- Capture token-level latency, model throughput, error rates, and memory/KV cache behavior.

2) Capacity guidance (ballpark):
- On our current Dedicated profile (NVIDIA A10g equivalent), a single node can sustain ~400-600 QPS for short bursts depending on model/token size; sustained 200-350 QPS with KV/cache reuse.
- If observed spikes exceed ~600 QPS, recommend horizontal scaling (add nodes) first — it provides better headroom and lower tail latency. Consider quantization for cost improvement but only after validating 1.0-level quality on a smaller run.

3) Deliverables & owners to include in MAP:
- Redwood: run the replay, produce KPI report, recommend Dedicated pool sizing (Aditya)
- ACME: provide traffic dump + access, validate redacted fields (Jordan / Priya)
- Ops: schedule maintenance window and test account (Vivek)

I can be available for the run week of Oct 12; suggest we lock the exact date once Jordan confirms the data drop.

Aditya
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
